messages:
olivia: Quick company note: running a 3-day compact SOC2+ISO evidence minisprint next Tue-Thu (2026-06-15 -> 2026-06-17). Target: control owners and manager attestations only. Keep artifacts tiny — screenshot, 1-line CSV row, or ticket link is fine. Form: https://go.redwood/compact-evidence :calendar:

olivia: What to include in the form (paste into the "notes" field if you're uploading a CSV):
```
- name
- role/team
- manager or "self" if IC owner
- control id or short name
- artifact type (screenshot/csv/ticket) + link
```

samir: Are we required to include older training certs or only those within 12 months?

olivia: Training within 12 months is acceptable. If older, mark as "stale" and add planned completion date.

jules: For shared service accounts, should I list all collateral owners or just primary?

olivia: List a primary owner and note collaborators (one-liner). If you cannot assign a primary owner, mark "unassigned" and security will follow up.

harper: I'm on site that week and can sign for my team. If a manager is traveling, delegation allowed via the "delegate" field in the form. Keep a short note for audit trail.

ops-reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled  DM to control owners and managers on 2026-06-15T09:00Z.

samir: Uploaded a CSV with service accounts and last-rotated dates. Tagged primary owners.

jules: Pushed a few screenshots and links to tickets. Marked 2 items as "exception requested" with ETA 2026-06-22.

olivia: Thanks all  audit will sample 10% of submissions after the sprint. If you hit blockers, add "exception requested" in the form with a short reason. We'll triage immediately.

harper: Noted  will batch my team's attestations by Tue morning.

ops-reminder-bot: Follow-up scheduled for 2026-06-17T16:00Z for outstanding items
